rationale: Alon is building dexterous manipulation technology for humanoid robots using learning-based approaches, and Udula is an ML engineer with robotics experience and a strong Python/C++ tech stack. Udula's background in ML infrastructure and systems programming could directly support the core technical challenges Aora is tackling around robot learning and control.
intro_message: Alon, meet Udula Abeykoon — an ML engineer at RBC Borealis with hands-on robotics experience and deep expertise in Python and C++, who could be valuable in building out the learning systems for Aora's dexterous manipulation work.
